title: Quick gate: a change in a shared crate falls back to the whole batch plan (1100 steps)

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P5
labels.description: Agent surface and tooling keep up with what shipped

body:
Refs #3556. The maintainer's words on 2026-11-22: "should be small targeted shallow tests".

## What happens
`cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` prints "shared crate / workspace touched (crates/geometry/src/geo2d.rs): quick falls back to batch" when a diff changes a file of a shared crate, or a `Cargo.toml`. The plan is then the whole batch tier:
- PR #3353 (one change in `geo2d.rs`): 1102 steps, with 653 app test binaries;
- PR #3363 (a `Cargo.toml`): 1099 steps;
- PR #2515 (one post script and one table in `posting_files.rs`): 773 steps;
- PR #3472 (turning): 721 steps; a wave of three small PRs: 588 steps.

A build of all app test binaries takes 50 GB or more of disk and 30 to 50 minutes. Reviewers and workers then select steps by hand, and a hand selection lost a red test two times on 2026-11-22 (#3486, and the catalog case of #3478).

## Wanted
- The quick plan selects by the real use: for a changed file of a shared crate, the test binaries that reach the changed items (for example by the module, or by the public items that the diff changes), not each binary of each crate that depends on the crate.
- A limit with a clear message: when the selection is over a set number of steps, the plan prints the reason for each group, so that a person can see why.
- The example catalog suites are selected where a post or a toolpath changed (#3521).
- Tests in `xtask/` pin the selection for the four cases above.

Related: #3513, #3514, #3515 (slow tests), #3521 (catalog selection).
